{
  "dataset_name": "credit_g",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "normalized_credit_amount",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Min-max normalized credit amount to ensure equal weighting in distance calculations.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents the large scale of credit_amount from dominating the Euclidean distance metric in KNN.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(credit_amount - 250.0) / 15695.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_duration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Min-max normalized loan duration.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardizes the duration feature to a [0, 1] scale, improving neighborhood geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(duration - 4.0) / 56.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_age",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Min-max normalized applicant age.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardizes the age feature to a [0, 1] scale, ensuring it contributes proportionally to distance metrics.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 20.0) / 48.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "amount_per_duration_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Monthly payment proxy (amount divided by duration), scaled and clipped to [0, 1].",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio_feature",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the intensity of the loan repayment schedule, normalized for distance-based models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((credit_amount / duration) / 1000.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "financial_commitment_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Combined index of installment commitment and existing credits, normalized to [0, 1].",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_index",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates multiple ordinal commitment features into a single continuous dimension for smoother distance calculations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(installment_commitment + existing_credits) / 7.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_duration_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of age to loan duration, scaled and clipped.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction_feature",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights applicants taking loans that span a significant portion of their age, providing a normalized geometric feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((age / duration) / 10.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "has_valuable_property_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator for owning real estate or life insurance.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a distinct spatial separation in the KNN feature space for applicants with significant collateral.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((property_magnitude == 'real estate') | (property_magnitude == 'life insurance'), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_average_applicant",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance to the mean values of credit_amount, duration, and age (using standardized values).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a radial basis feature measuring how typical or anomalous an applicant's core numeric profile is.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((credit_amount - 3778.04) / 3166.38)**2 + ((duration - 22.01) / 13.24)**2 + ((age - 35.35) / 11.20)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "generic_high_risk_profile_similarity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic similarity score to a generic high-risk profile (e.g., no checking, low savings, renting, unskilled).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Embeds complex categorical combinations into a single continuous similarity metric, ideal for KNN.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "generic_stable_profile_similarity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic similarity score to a generic stable profile (e.g., high savings, own housing, skilled job, long employment).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous spatial dimension representing overall financial stability based on categorical attributes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "employment_stability_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score evaluating the stability of employment based on duration and job type.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Translates ordinal and categorical employment data into a smooth numeric scale for distance computation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "credit_history_quality_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score evaluating the quality of past credit history and existing credits.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Converts categorical credit history descriptions into a continuous metric, improving neighborhood resolution.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
